source.title: ScientistOne: Towards Human-Level Autonomous Research via Chain-of-Evidence

observations.text: ScientistOne's Paper Writer first creates a research representation where factual claims carry inline evidence tags to workspace artifacts. Ground validates artifact existence and selected numeric/baseline relations; the Claim Verifier checks claims against declared sources. Numerical CPR specifically binds numbered sentences to experimental_log.md line references and reports 627/639 automatic passes (98.1%), with manual review estimating only 2-4 genuine mismatches among the 12 flags (~99% corrected CPR).

The final LaTeX deliberately strips all inline evidence annotations after refinement. Therefore internal native provenance and exported-paper provenance are distinct properties: a high internal CPR does not by itself imply that a downstream consumer of the final paper can reconstruct sentence-to-artifact bindings without an additional sidecar or workspace artifact.

Method-Code Alignment is not deterministic in ScientistOne's audit: an LLM compares the paper method section with solution code and majority vote is used. The audit also re-executes solutions for Score Verification. Thus the full published CoE audit is not a zero-external-executor, zero-model-dependency scheduled-Chat verification mechanism under the current Phase-1 acceptance rule, although its claim-tagging pattern is useful evidence-packaging precedent.

The current official generated-artifacts repository is heterogeneous by task family. ADRS solution-code exposes final per-seed .py files alongside generated PDFs, while an MLE example (ai4code) additionally exposes best_run_meta.json, evaluation_metrics.json, ablation/, and search_artifacts/. Repository code search found no experimental_log.md. Absence is scoped only to the current observed official repository surface, not to private or separately hosted workspace artifacts.

protocol_inferences.name: CLAIM_EVIDENCE_MAP_PERSISTENCE
protocol_inferences.text: If verification depends on claim-to-artifact bindings, persist those bindings in a machine-readable exported sidecar keyed by stable claim/span identity and artifact digest. Stripping inline tags from the final prose must not erase the only replay path.

protocol_inferences.name: REPLAY_MODE_DECLARATION
protocol_inferences.text: Evidence packages should declare whether each verification result is replayable by static inspection, semantic/LLM review, or code re-execution. A dependency-bearing replay mode cannot be silently counted as scheduled-Chat-native Phase-1 acceptance.

protocol_inferences.name: EXPORT_COVERAGE_PARITY
protocol_inferences.text: Export/publication packaging should preserve sufficient claim-evidence coverage to reproduce the verifier's material conclusions; internal provenance coverage must not be inferred from a stripped export.

protocol_inferences.name: ARTIFACT_FAMILY_COMPLETENESS
protocol_inferences.text: Replayability claims must be evaluated per task/artifact family. A rich archive for one benchmark family cannot establish replayability for another family that publishes a thinner artifact set.

phase1_acceptance.reason: The demonstrated end-to-end audit uses model-based semantic judgments and re-execution, and the public export does not uniformly preserve the internal native claim-evidence map. These are unresolved dependencies under zero-monthly-quota, zero-incremental-cost, scheduled-Chat-native Phase-1 rules.
phase1_acceptance.usable_pattern: Static machine-readable claim-to-artifact sidecars with immutable digests are a promising evidence-packaging component if their verification predicates themselves remain inspectable and dependency-free.

scope_notes: No claim is made that ScientistOne lacks unpublished/private experimental logs.
No claim is made that all MLE or Parameter Golf artifacts have identical completeness; heterogeneity is established only by the inspected current paths.
No causal claim is made that preserving exported claim maps improves benchmark performance; this is a replay/auditability invariant.
